scope: Second four-file preview preparation draft; no implementation changes. Prior PREP01/02 receipt preserved.

prior_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-01: Resolved by plain captured let arrangement=band.
prior_findings.PREVIEW-PREP-02: Shared final prepared predicate and retained lease handoff address stale output/arrangement checks, subject to corrections below.

findings.title: Cancellation invalidates readiness before ownership-sensitive rejection cleanup
findings.evidence: cancel invokes request.cancel before rejection. AudioReadiness.isCurrent includes !task.isCancelled, so startMelody rejection if request.isCurrent cannot stop a canceled request. If readiness completes before gate consumption, no unfinished readiness body remains to stop the installed metronome; lease release sees metronomeRunning and keeps output active.
findings.requested_change: Clear and invalidate gate state while retaining local old handles. Invoke ownership-sensitive rejection before canceling the captured request, or snapshot command ownership independently. Preserve protection against old cancellation stopping a newer request. Test ready-but-unconsumed cancellation and replacement.

findings.title: Final predicate omits phase qualification after suspension
findings.evidence: The pre-handoff guard requires phase.stage, but final predicate checks only output lease,arrangement and cache. startChords can change phase.playing without canceling pending audioStart; an older melody startup can overwrite the newer phase.
findings.requested_change: Retain phase==.stage in the final prepared predicate immediately before clock start.

test_assessment: Held actual session activation plus AudioPreviewLease instance/current closure meaningfully exercises final prepared consumption and one release.
Pending-activation repeated cancellation verifies one-shot rejection but misses already-completed readiness before gate consumption and old/new ownership.
No direct exact-arrangement/current-rate cache regression is added. Real native preview remains required.
api_note: Explicit afterReady label at old startMelody trailing-closure call avoids Swift<6 backward matching compatibility. Project uses Swift5.10; this is not an executed compiler failure.
limits: No Swift compilation or XCTest execution on Windows; native tests remain unrun.
